name: Seattle, Washington
description:
Went here as a kid - all I remember is "hiking to the top of Mt. Rainier" (we definitely did not do that).
    But we hiked in the (July) snow, got turned around, and I slipped and fell so many times I found it hilarious. I still have
    the 3-foot-tall hiking pole from this trip.

name: Cancun, Mexico
description: Visited with my family when I was young, we enjoyed the beach and visiting Chichén Itzá.

name: San Francisco, California
description: Visited with family when I was in middle school. I don't remember too much, but the hills and finding the city beautiful. Have to go back soon.

name: Paris, France
description: First time in Europe. Especially loved the Musée d'Orsay. The apartment we stayed in was so hot.

name: New Orleans, Louisiana
description: Rode streetcars, got beignets, visited the cemetery on a cold windy day.

name: Tokyo, Japan
description:
Did a semester abroad as a Junior in college, studying Japanese mostly, at Meikai University in Urayasu.
    I lived about a 12 minute walk from Higashi Funabashi station on JR's Chuo-Soubu line. Very much enjoyed going to Taito arcades,
    the shrine up the street from my dorm, and exploring Tokyo. Absolute best spot was the observation deck at Odaiba. Also enjoyed 
    a ~weeklong trip to Kyoto during Christmas.

name: Cosby, Tennesee
description: My first roadtrip not with my family. We had an absolutely splendid time, staying in a charming house adjacent to GSMNP. Hiked Ramsey Cascades, drove along Foothills Parkway, and had a great time.

name: Portland, Oregon
description:
We mostly stayed in the city here, visiting Powell's bookstore, the Japanese gardens (after a lovely long walk to it), and exploring via streetcar. The gondola was
    quite a ride as well.

name: Asheville, North Carolina
description:
This was our second GSMNP road trip. Stayed in a hotel in downtown Asheville, which was a lovely little downtown. Various short hikes (Catawba falls, Lake Powhatan),
    and ziplined with Navitat.

name: New York, New York
description: Saw Hadestown at the Walter Kerr, which is perhaps my favorite musical. Did the usual NYC touristy things, and had a blast. Froze in the blizzard, though.

name: Washington, D.C.
description: This was our trip to test the waters to see if we might want to move to the area. We stayed just outside of DC in Silver Spring, with a rental car. Hiked Sugarloaf in MD, and thoroughly enjoyed exploring DC via the metro.

name: Iceland
description: This was an awesome 4 day road (and ferry!) trip from Reykjavik, around the golden circle, to Vestmannaeyjar, and eventually to Vik.

name: Los Angeles, California
description: I spent just a few days in Santa Monica, and running around LA, for my best friend's birthday. Hiked Malibu Creek State Park, visited Griffith Observatory.
